title: Wayfare Pass Pausing — Desk Guidance on Scheduling and Frequency
content:
# Pausing a membership — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule

1. Pausing is offered only on plans whose terms allow it, only on an active membership with auto-renew on, and is the member's own decision.
2. A pause covers between the plan's shortest and longest pause in whole billing months; it starts on the day after the last day of the current period, so the period already paid is used in full, and the pause's last day is recorded as the date the membership is paused until.
3. A new pause may be scheduled only once the previous pause is far enough back: the pause frequency is counted in calendar months from the start date of the previous pause; the new pause may be scheduled on or after the same day-of-month, the plan's pause frequency in calendar months later, or the last day of that month when the day does not exist.
4. While paused there are no fees and no benefits; on the day after the pause's last day a new period begins with a renewal charge.

## The frequency test

- **Clock starts**: the start date of the previous pause, as the membership record shows it.
- **Counting**: calendar months, landing on the same day-of-month; where that day does not exist in the landing month, the last day of that month.
- **Comparison**: the new pause may be scheduled *on or after* the landing day; the landing day itself qualifies.

Boundary cases on a 12-month frequency (hypothetical dates):

| Previous pause started | Landing day | Scheduling on | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 June | 15 June of the next year | 15 June of the next year | yes (on the landing day) |
| 15 June | 15 June of the next year | 14 June of the next year | no (the day before) |
| 29 February | 28 February of the next year (no 29th) | 28 February of the next year | yes |

## Status movements

| From | Event | To |
|---|---|---|
| active | a scheduled pause starts on the renewal date instead of a renewal charge | paused |
| paused | the pause ends; a new paid period begins with a renewal charge | active |
| paused | the member ends the paused membership | cancelled |

## Hypothetical case

A Wayfare Pass Monthly member whose current period ends on 31 March and who has never paused schedules a 2-month pause. The pause starts on 1 April, no renewal is charged while paused, and on the day after the pause's last day a new period begins with a renewal charge.
